question: Police of which State/UT launched the Anubhuti-QR Code-based feedback system in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** redesigned Delhi Police website, e-Chittha, and Anubhuti**, a QR code-based feedback system, were all introduced by the Delhi Police on February 28, 2012.
 
• The Delhi Police's duty deployment would be supported by the **e-Chittha portal**.
 
• With its implementation, the department will have eight-hour shifts, ensuring the best possible use of labour resources while also improving the** Delhi police's efficiency and transparency**.
 
• Delhi currently has** 6 ranges, 15 districts, and 209 police stations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The current **YUVA 2.0 project** by the Delhi Police seeks to engage youth by improving their abilities in accordance with their competencies.
 
• According to the Prime Minister's Mantra of "**aatma-nirbharta**" of the Ministry of Skill Development, Government of India, it will assist them in finding gainful work.
 
• Police and the general public will be able to communicate with each other through the Anubhuti - **Feedback Management System**.
 
• The department will have **8-hour **shifts thanks to "**e-Chittha**," which will also improve employee **productivity and transparency**.
 
• Three new digital efforts from the Delhi Police have just been unveiled: the e-Chittha portal, Anubhuti, a QR code-based feedback system, and the Delhi Police website.
 
• **Rakesh Asthana,** the commissioner of the Delhi Police, announced their start. The Robocop, which was displayed during the inaugural event, is also being investigated by the **Delhi Police**.
 
• A t**wo-way conversation** with the public will be established using the **Anubhuti feedback management system**.
